name: ShadcnPageRoute
description: Widgets-only page route and declarative Page with the shadcn fade + slide transition.

transitions: buildTransitions ignores secondaryAnimation: a covered page does not animate out

notes: No <name>_style.dart / <name>_theme.dart: a route has no token-derived surface, so there is nothing to theme.
`kDefaultPageTransitionDuration` was renamed to `kShadcnPageTransitionDuration` so it cannot be confused with foundation's `kDefaultDuration` (150ms).
preview.dart imports the `button` and `dialog` components for the demo; preview files are excluded from dependency checking.
